verify mcp projections retain agent api redaction and never return command or output bodies.

own spawned process trees and terminate their descendants across windows jobs and unix process groups.
dropping an active process owner or shutting down the app cannot intentionally leave its registered descendants running.

repository folder operations are normalized against the selected workspace and surface closed error codes.

inspect repository status and remotes with bounded read-only git processes, shared in-flight requests, and cache diagnostics.
inspections avoid credential helpers and index writes, and concurrent callers for one repository share the same in-flight result.
validate, persist, and read bounded repository-import attempt state and phase records from the native sqlite store.
only closed source-kind, state, and phase values with required repository identity and timestamps are written.

strict storage parsing rejects unsupported versions; canonicalization accepts only reachable unique nodes and repository sources.

edits build on the latest draft, writes compare the last accepted snapshot, conflicts require reload, and only the live initiating view receives feedback.
clone, inspect, initialize, synchronize, fork, and publish project repositories through bounded native git operations.
native and github failures are returned as closed domain error codes rather than successful repository state.

inspections avoid credentials and optional locks, while mutations use bounded processes and return closed repository errors.

malformed native responses never become successful typed task results.
discover toolchain commands, launch bounded repository tasks in terminals, persist execution-owned records, and project process liveness without overwriting results.

preview and apply commands use the opening workspace; only the live dialog and its selected repository, scope, and profile receive results or busy-state cleanup.
plan and apply repository scaffolds with exclusive ownership, durable journals, conflict preservation, and recovery.
apply writes missing files only, and cleanup verifies repository parents and recorded checksums before removing generated files.
define versioned project registry records, mutation inputs, result shapes, and field limits.
project registry consumers share one versioned set of record shapes, mutation results, and field limits.
persist workspace project registries through tauri sqlite while migrating and preserving the browser legacy fallback.
overlapping writes run in request order, legacy promotion rechecks sqlite before writing, and subscriptions publish only the latest successful result while still active.
read and atomically replace sqlite project registry snapshots with optional stale-write guards.
guarded writes replace only the expected stored snapshot; a conflict or invalid row rolls back the entire batch.
resolve repository tasks into commands using package scripts, local dependency ownership, and supported toolchain manifests.
only closed repository task variants select commands, discovery skips generated dependencies, and root scripts retain priority over nested projects.

read selected durable repository task runs by identity without reducing historical evidence to the latest run.

scope changes clear foreign run state while retaining matching repositories; metadata-only changes reuse polling, queued refreshes supersede snapshots, and teardown removes listeners and timers.
match native task records to registered repositories and format task state feedback.
windows path spellings share a comparison key while unix names remain case-sensitive; record order selects the latest run and every accepted repository id maps only to its own records.
load project board registries, operation history, and vault views within the active workspace lifetime.
initial reads yield to newer published and live state; only the active workspace lifetime updates the board, and metadata changes preserve selections.
compile deterministic markdown prompt documents and agent briefs from typed sections and workduck entity references.
prompt output preserves the declared section order and ends with one normalized newline.

constructed and transitioned artifacts retain their versioned schema identity and valid lifecycle states.

saving captures its workspace and report selection, and late feedback never changes a newer selection.

a matching evaluator source report may have only one delegation; updating that same file stays allowed, and duplicate scans honor queue file size and count limits.

execution requires an explicit confirmation token and never converts an unknown native response into success.
validate and coordinate native multi-agent queue execution, secret resolution, cancellation, confirmation, and exclusive result-report creation.
execution verifies the estimate token against the locked work-order snapshot before state changes, respects global and provider permits, and never exposes resolved secrets through prompt previews.
build secret-free prompt previews and bounded execution plans, resolve run configuration, and bind execution confirmation to the reviewed prompts.
previews never resolve api secrets, run and task caps are checked before resolution, and confirmation validates the supplied locked work-order snapshot against the reviewed prompt estimate token.
own queue context menu placement, dismissal, and workspace-scoped single or bulk file deletion.
deletion captures the initiating workspace and applies partial results and feedback only while that view is current; menu subscriptions are disposed when closed.

define native queue command responses, stable error codes, and known artifact directory and suffix contracts.
existing native command response names, field omission, and error strings remain stable.
enforce native queue directory, path, size, count, exclusive-write, update, delete, and evaluation-delegation constraints.
only known queue child directories and file suffixes are addressable; artifact writes and deletes share the workspace lock, and create operations never overwrite an existing artifact.
coordinate queue panel state, workspace lifetimes, artifact selection, prompt previews, and user-initiated workflows.
operation results update only their captured workspace lifetime; execution context and vault stay bound to the initiating workspace.
project live queue catalog records and language messages into sorted skill options and display labels.

only the latest open preview for the captured workspace and selected work order receives an estimate; closing invalidates pending responses.
track workspace-scoped queue read markers, unread counts, pruning, and browser change notifications.

each editor owns its draft and keeps form bindings reactive; save values use the existing queue draft rules.

stored references require a matching workspace and collection, legacy revisions start at zero, and mutations retain the loaded revision for stale-write rejection.

unknown or failed native responses never report connected success and return a disconnected snapshot.
